scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: The person operating a motor vehicle.
To leave a vehicle stationary, whether occupied or not, other than temporarily stopping to obey signs, signals and similar devices; PARKED describes a vehicle left in this way.
To allow a vehicle to stand idling, whether occupied or not, other than temporarily stopping to obey signs, signals and similar devices.
To bring a vehicle to a halt, even briefly.
The width between the boundary lines of a publicly maintained way any part of which is open to the public for vehicular travel.
A parking space designated as disabled parking, reserved for individuals with disabilities.

rules.title: Secure the vehicle when leaving it
rules.when: leaving the vehicle
rules.action: turn the motor off, set the parking brake and remove the key
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST turn the motor off, set the parking brake and remove the key.

rules.title: Look behind before opening the door
rules.when: about to open the car door
rules.action: look behind for any oncoming traffic
rules.statement: WHEN about to open the car door, the DRIVER MUST look behind for any oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Unattended vehicle: engine off, ignition locked, key removed
rules.when: leaving the vehicle to STAND unattended
rules.action: turn off the engine, lock the ignition and remove the key from the ignition
rules.unless: the engine was started by a remote starter or similar device that starts the engine without the key in the ignition
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle to STAND unattended, the DRIVER MUST turn off the engine, lock the ignition and remove the key from the ignition, UNLESS the engine was started by a remote starter or similar device that starts the engine without the key in the ignition.
rules.note: Handbook says it is illegal to permit a car to stand idling unattended without these steps.

rules.title: Unattended vehicle: set the brake
rules.when: leaving the vehicle to STAND unattended
rules.action: set the brake
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle to STAND unattended, the DRIVER MUST set the brake.
rules.note: The remote-starter exception in 8.43 does not cover setting the brake.

rules.title: Unattended on a grade: turn wheels to curb
rules.when: leaving the vehicle to STAND unattended on any grade
rules.action: turn the front wheels to the curb or side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle to STAND unattended on any grade, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels to the curb or side of the road.
rules.note: The 'Parking on Hills' section (8.53) has only a heading; its diagrams are missing.

rules.title: Remote-started vehicle: key before operating
rules.when: about to operate a vehicle whose engine was started by a remote starter
rules.action: have the key placed in the ignition or physically present in the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN about to operate a vehicle whose engine was started by a remote starter, the DRIVER MUST have the key placed in the ignition or physically present in the vehicle.

rules.title: Leaving a parking space: check mirrors
rules.when: leaving any parking space
rules.action: use caution and check all mirrors to make sure nothing, especially pedestrians or children, is obstructing the vehicle's path
rules.statement: WHEN leaving any parking space, the DRIVER MUST use caution and check all mirrors to make sure nothing, especially pedestrians or children, is obstructing the vehicle's path.
rules.note: Reason given: children often play between parked cars.

rules.title: Look back while backing out
rules.when: backing up out of a parking space
rules.action: look back before and while backing up
rules.statement: WHEN backing up out of a parking space, the DRIVER MUST look back before and while backing up.

rules.title: Signal when leaving a parking space
rules.when: leaving a parking space, including pulling away from a parking space parallel to the curb
rules.action: signal
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a parking space, including pulling away from a parking space parallel to the curb, the DRIVER MUST signal.

rules.title: No running motor in a garage
rules.when: the vehicle is in a garage
rules.action: leave the motor running
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is in a garage, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the motor running.
rules.note: Reason given: carbon monoxide poisoning.

rules.title: No running motor with windows closed while parked
rules.when: the vehicle is PARKED
rules.action: leave the motor running with the windows closed
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is PARKED, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the motor running with the windows closed.
rules.note: Reason given: carbon monoxide poisoning.

rules.title: No heater or A/C in parked car in enclosed space
rules.when: the vehicle is PARKED in an enclosed space with the windows closed
rules.action: use the heater or air conditioner
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is PARKED in an enclosed space with the windows closed, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the heater or air conditioner.
rules.note: Reason given: carbon monoxide poisoning.

rules.title: No double parking
rules.when: on the road side of any vehicle stopped or PARKED at the edge or curb of a street
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on the road side of any vehicle stopped or PARKED at the edge or curb of a street, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: Section heading says 'Do Not'; the introductory paragraph says 'should not'; the stronger wording is recorded. Temporarily stopping to obey signs or signals is not parking or standing (8.12).

rules.title: Not on sidewalk or crosswalk
rules.when: on a sidewalk or crosswalk
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a sidewalk or crosswalk, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: Heading 'Do Not' vs paragraph 'should not'; stronger recorded. See 8.12 on temporary stops to obey signs/signals.

rules.title: Not within an intersection
rules.when: within an intersection
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within an intersection, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: Heading 'Do Not' vs paragraph 'should not'; stronger recorded. See 8.12 on temporary stops to obey signs/signals.

rules.title: Not at a safety zone
rules.when: between a safety zone and the adjacent curb OR within 30 feet of a place on the curb immediately opposite the end of a safety zone
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN between a safety zone and the adjacent curb OR within 30 feet of a place on the curb immediately opposite the end of a safety zone, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: 'Safety zone' is not defined in the handbook. Heading 'Do Not' vs paragraph 'should not'; stronger recorded.

rules.title: Not beside an excavation or obstruction
rules.when: alongside or opposite any street excavation or obstruction AND stopping, standing or parking there would obstruct traffic
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN alongside or opposite any street excavation or obstruction AND stopping, standing or parking there would obstruct traffic, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: Heading 'Do Not' vs paragraph 'should not'; stronger recorded.

rules.title: Not on a bridge or in a tunnel
rules.when: on a bridge or other elevated structure on a HIGHWAY OR within a HIGHWAY tunnel
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a bridge or other elevated structure on a HIGHWAY OR within a HIGHWAY tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: Heading 'Do Not' vs paragraph 'should not'; stronger recorded.

rules.title: Not on railroad or light rail tracks
rules.when: on any railroad track, including light rail tracks
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on any railroad track, including light rail tracks, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: 8.3 says 'should not'; 5.49 says 'Never stop on the tracks'; 10.171 says stopping or parking on light rail tracks is dangerous and illegal. Strongest wording recorded.

rules.title: Official sign prohibits stopping
rules.when: an official sign prohibits stopping
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN an official sign prohibits stopping, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: Regulatory signs must be obeyed like traffic laws (6.115).

rules.title: Emergency-only shoulder
rules.when: a regulatory sign designates the shoulder of the road for emergency use only
rules.action: STOP on the shoulder
rules.unless: the vehicle is required to stop because of mechanical breakdown, tire trouble, lack of fuel or other emergencies
rules.statement: WHEN a regulatory sign designates the shoulder of the road for emergency use only, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP on the shoulder, UNLESS the vehicle is required to stop because of mechanical breakdown, tire trouble, lack of fuel or other emergencies.

vague_terms.explanation: which emergencies qualify is not listed

rules.note: The sign itself is a missing image; only its description is used. The description says 'should only be used', but it is listed as a regulatory sign, which must be obeyed (6.115).

rules.title: Not in front of a driveway
rules.when: in front of a public or private driveway
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN in front of a public or private driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Not within 15 feet of a fire hydrant
rules.when: within 15 feet of a fire hydrant
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 feet of a fire hydrant, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Not within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection
rules.when: within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Not within 30 feet before a roadside signal or sign
rules.when: within 30 feet upon the approach to any flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign or other traffic control signal located at the side of a road
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 feet upon the approach to any flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign or other traffic control signal located at the side of a road, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Not within 20 feet of a fire station driveway
rules.when: within 20 feet of the driveway entrance to any fire station
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 20 feet of the driveway entrance to any fire station, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Not opposite a fire station entrance within 75 feet
rules.when: on the side of a street opposite the entrance to any fire station AND within 75 feet of that entrance
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN on the side of a street opposite the entrance to any fire station AND within 75 feet of that entrance, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Official sign prohibits parking or standing
rules.when: an official sign prohibits parking or standing
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN an official sign prohibits parking or standing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.
rules.note: Regulatory signs must be obeyed like traffic laws (6.115).

rules.title: Not on a street where a fire truck answered an alarm
rules.when: on the street where a fire truck has answered an alarm
rules.action: drive or PARK
rules.statement: WHEN on the street where a fire truck has answered an alarm, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive or PARK.

rules.title: Do not block ambulance access
rules.when: near the scene of an emergency
rules.action: PARK in a location that interferes with the arrival or departure of an ambulance to or from the scene
rules.statement: WHEN near the scene of an emergency, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK in a location that interferes with the arrival or departure of an ambulance to or from the scene.

rules.title: Not within 50 feet of a railroad crossing
rules.when: within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing
rules.action: PARK the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Official sign prohibits parking
rules.when: an official sign prohibits parking
rules.action: PARK the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN an official sign prohibits parking, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle.
rules.note: Regulatory signs must be obeyed like traffic laws (6.115).

rules.title: Rural highway: park off the road when possible
rules.when: on the paved part of any HIGHWAY outside of a business or residential district AND the DRIVER can PARK off the road
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle on the paved part
rules.statement: WHEN on the paved part of any HIGHWAY outside of a business or residential district AND the DRIVER can PARK off the road, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle on the paved part.

rules.title: Cannot park off road: leave room to pass
rules.when: the DRIVER cannot PARK off the road AND leaves the vehicle on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district
rules.action: leave plenty of room for others to pass
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER cannot PARK off the road AND leaves the vehicle on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district, the DRIVER MUST leave plenty of room for others to pass.

rules.title: Cannot park off road: visible for 200 feet
rules.when: the DRIVER cannot PARK off the road AND leaves the vehicle on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district
rules.action: make sure the vehicle can be seen for at least 200 feet from each direction
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER cannot PARK off the road AND leaves the vehicle on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district, the DRIVER MUST make sure the vehicle can be seen for at least 200 feet from each direction.

rules.title: Cannot park off road at night: lights
rules.when: the DRIVER cannot PARK off the road AND leaves the vehicle on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district AND it is night
rules.action: use the parking lights or leave the headlights on dim
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER cannot PARK off the road AND leaves the vehicle on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district AND it is night, the DRIVER MUST use the parking lights or leave the headlights on dim.

rules.title: Parked on unlighted highway at night
rules.when: the DRIVER must PARK on an unlighted HIGHWAY at night
rules.action: leave the parking lights or low beam headlights on
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER must PARK on an unlighted HIGHWAY at night, the DRIVER MUST leave the parking lights or low beam headlights on.

rules.title: Breakdown: move off the pavement
rules.when: the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: move the car off the pavement to the side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST move the car off the pavement to the side of the road.
rules.note: The handbook adds that a car with a flat tire or blowout can be driven slowly off the road.

rules.title: Breakdown on the road: get everyone out
rules.when: the vehicle breaks down AND the DRIVER cannot get the car off the road
rules.action: get everyone out of the car and off the road
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle breaks down AND the DRIVER cannot get the car off the road, the DRIVER MUST get everyone out of the car and off the road.

rules.title: Breakdown on the road: warning devices
rules.when: the vehicle breaks down AND the DRIVER cannot get the car off the road
rules.action: use portable warning devices to warn oncoming traffic
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle breaks down AND the DRIVER cannot get the car off the road, the DRIVER SHOULD use portable warning devices to warn oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Breakdown: warning lights
rules.when: the vehicle has broken down
rules.action: turn on the emergency warning lights, or the taillights if the vehicle has no warning lights
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has broken down, the DRIVER MUST turn on the emergency warning lights, or the taillights if the vehicle has no warning lights.

rules.title: Breakdown at night: interior lights
rules.when: the vehicle has broken down AND it is night
rules.action: turn on the lights inside the car in addition to the taillights and warning lights
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has broken down AND it is night, the DRIVER MUST turn on the lights inside the car in addition to the taillights and warning lights.

rules.title: Breakdown: white cloth or raised hood
rules.when: the vehicle has broken down
rules.action: tie a white cloth to the radio antenna, door handle or other place where it may be easily seen, or raise the hood if no white cloth is available
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has broken down, the DRIVER MUST tie a white cloth to the radio antenna, door handle or other place where it may be easily seen, or raise the hood if no white cloth is available.

rules.title: Stopped by law enforcement: where to park
rules.when: stopped by law enforcement
rules.action: slow down, move the vehicle safely to the right of the road and PARK as far to the right of the main traffic lane as possible, on the right shoulder if available or otherwise on a nearby well-lighted side street or parking lot away from high volume traffic
rules.statement: WHEN stopped by law enforcement, the DRIVER SHOULD slow down, move the vehicle safely to the right of the road and PARK as far to the right of the main traffic lane as possible, on the right shoulder if available or otherwise on a nearby well-lighted side street or parking lot away from high volume traffic.
rules.note: Worded as 'it is suggested'.

rules.title: Stopped by law enforcement: secure the vehicle
rules.when: PARKED after being stopped by law enforcement
rules.action: place the vehicle in a parking position, set the emergency brake, turn the engine off and activate the hazard warning lights
rules.statement: WHEN PARKED after being stopped by law enforcement, the DRIVER SHOULD place the vehicle in a parking position, set the emergency brake, turn the engine off and activate the hazard warning lights.
rules.note: Worded as 'it is suggested'.

rules.title: Stopped by law enforcement at night: dome light
rules.when: PARKED after being stopped by law enforcement AND it is night
rules.action: turn on the interior dome light
rules.statement: WHEN PARKED after being stopped by law enforcement AND it is night, the DRIVER SHOULD turn on the interior dome light.
rules.note: Worded as 'it is suggested'.

rules.title: Disabled parking space
rules.when: at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE
rules.action: PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle in the space
rules.unless: the vehicle has a disabled license plate or a state-issued removable windshield identification card
rules.statement: WHEN at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle in the space, UNLESS the vehicle has a disabled license plate or a state-issued removable windshield identification card.
rules.penalty: Misdemeanor: $500 to $750 fine for a first offense, rising to $1,250 for five or more offenses; additional offenses include community service.
rules.note: 8.31 states the prohibition without exception; 8.33 and the sign description in 6.122 give the plate/card exception; 8.38 notes certain municipalities prohibit stopping or standing unless the card is visible or the vehicle has a disabled plate.

rules.title: Windshield card only when transporting its holder
rules.when: PARKING in a DISABLED PARKING SPACE with a disabled parking windshield identification card
rules.action: use the card
rules.unless: transporting the disabled person to whom it was issued
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING in a DISABLED PARKING SPACE with a disabled parking windshield identification card, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the card, UNLESS transporting the disabled person to whom it was issued.

rules.title: Do not block access or curb ramps
rules.when: near an access or curb ramp
rules.action: block the access or curb ramp
rules.statement: WHEN near an access or curb ramp, the DRIVER MUST NOT block the access or curb ramp.

rules.title: Not in striped areas next to disabled spaces
rules.when: in a striped area adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE OR in a striped area in front of a business entrance adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN in a striped area adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE OR in a striped area in front of a business entrance adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: Reason given: striped areas are for wheelchair lifts.

rules.title: Choose a large enough space
rules.when: about to parallel PARK
rules.action: choose a space large enough for the car to fit
rules.statement: WHEN about to parallel PARK, the DRIVER MUST choose a space large enough for the car to fit.

rules.title: Signal before passing the spot
rules.when: about to parallel PARK
rules.action: signal before passing the spot to alert drivers behind
rules.statement: WHEN about to parallel PARK, the DRIVER MUST signal before passing the spot to alert drivers behind.

rules.title: Starting position
rules.when: about to parallel PARK
rules.action: signal and then stop even with the front of the car ahead of the space, about two feet out from the space
rules.statement: WHEN about to parallel PARK, the DRIVER MUST signal and then stop even with the front of the car ahead of the space, about two feet out from the space.
rules.note: Handbook says 'stop even with the front of the car'; read as the car ahead of the space. Diagrams are missing.

rules.title: Begin backing toward the curb
rules.when: beginning to back into a parallel parking space
rules.action: make sure the vehicle will not interfere with oncoming traffic, then turn the front wheels all the way to the right and back slowly toward the curb
rules.statement: WHEN beginning to back into a parallel parking space, the DRIVER MUST make sure the vehicle will not interfere with oncoming traffic, then turn the front wheels all the way to the right and back slowly toward the curb.

rules.title: Two-way roadway: within 18 inches of right curb
rules.when: on a roadway that allows two-way traffic
rules.action: PARK with the vehicle's right-hand wheels within 18 inches of the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway
rules.statement: WHEN on a roadway that allows two-way traffic, the DRIVER MUST PARK with the vehicle's right-hand wheels within 18 inches of the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway.
rules.note: The glossary (16.109) says a parallel-parked vehicle must be 6 to 18 inches from the curb.

rules.title: Turn wheel left at the rear bumper
rules.when: backing into a parallel parking space AND the front seat is opposite the rear bumper of the car ahead
rules.action: turn the steering wheel all the way to the left and back slowly toward the car behind without touching it
rules.statement: WHEN backing into a parallel parking space AND the front seat is opposite the rear bumper of the car ahead, the DRIVER MUST turn the steering wheel all the way to the left and back slowly toward the car behind without touching it.

rules.title: About six inches from the curb
rules.when: parallel PARKED
rules.action: be about six inches from the curb
rules.statement: WHEN parallel PARKED, the DRIVER SHOULD be about six inches from the curb.

rules.title: Not more than 18 inches from the curb
rules.when: parallel PARKED
rules.action: leave the vehicle more than 18 inches from the curb or edge of the road
rules.statement: WHEN parallel PARKED, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the vehicle more than 18 inches from the curb or edge of the road.
rules.note: Overlaps PARK-PARA-05, which is a stated legal requirement for two-way roadways; this instruction is not limited to two-way roads.

rules.title: Straighten and center
rules.when: the car has been backed into a parallel parking space
rules.action: straighten the front wheels, pull into the final parking position and center the car in the space
rules.statement: WHEN the car has been backed into a parallel parking space, the DRIVER MUST straighten the front wheels, pull into the final parking position and center the car in the space.

rules.title: Bicycle on a sidewalk
rules.when: on a sidewalk
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the bicycle on the sidewalk
rules.unless: the bicycle impedes the normal and reasonable movement of pedestrian or other traffic on the sidewalk
rules.statement: WHEN on a sidewalk, the CYCLIST MAY STOP, STAND or PARK the bicycle on the sidewalk, UNLESS the bicycle impedes the normal and reasonable movement of pedestrian or other traffic on the sidewalk.
rules.note: Listed oddly under highway parking outside urban areas.

rules.title: Move off the street to stop or park a bicycle
rules.when: needing to stop, PARK or make repairs to the bicycle
rules.action: move off the street
rules.statement: WHEN needing to stop, PARK or make repairs to the bicycle, the CYCLIST MUST move off the street.
rules.note: Given as a bicycle safety guideline.
